cannot_check_now_reason: No content-disjoint outcome-unopened source family, rights freeze, population adapter, or independent audit is bound in this V4 handoff.

confirmation_target.learner_balancer_main_effect_recall_at_0: Same positive sign in at least four of five review-level decisions (or a prespecified analogue if family size differs), absolute unweighted mean >= 0.01, and magnitude >= half the locked development full-arm gap.
confirmation_target.tail: Report recall@5, recall@20, fraction screened to 95% recall, and WSS@95 per review and unweighted means.

required_before_execution: Bind a lawful source family whose canonical content identities are disjoint from all five SWIFT review decisions.
Keep every eligible review; define exclusions, labels, deduplication, seeds, batches, margins, endpoints and aggregation before any outcome is opened.
Independently audit the population adapter and source rights.
Freeze the same four 2x2 cells or a logically justified single selected-component contrast before outcomes.
Retain the active u4 comparator and the V3 safety gates; do not relax the +0.05 primary margin or harm/work-saving gates.
Predeclare that failure preserves the V1/V2/V3/V4 terminals and cannot be repaired by review deletion, pooled-row substitution or post-result tuning.
selected_mechanism_for_prospective_test_: Learner/balancer component L1 relative to L0, retaining both R0 and R1 representations unless a pre-outcome protocol specifies a single contrast.
